name: opencli-plugins
description: OpenCLI plugin monorepo: sim + google-trends + google-suggest + query-domain + ahrefs + namecheap + sem + aitdk + gsc + steamdb

scripts.build: npm run build -w opencli-plugin-sim && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-google-trends && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-google-suggest && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-query-domain && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-ahrefs && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-namecheap && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-sem && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-aitdk && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-gsc && npm run build -w opencli-plugin-steamdb
